It is located in the valley of the Daxia River (a right tributary of the Yellow River), 150 km (93 mi) (by road) southwest of the provincial capital Lanzhou.

cities.name: Nenjiang
cities.description: Nenjiang City, formerly Nenjiang County, is a county-level city under the administration of Heihe prefecture-level city in northwestern Heilongjiang province, China. It is located on the river of the same name (Nen River), which also forms part of the provincial border with Inner Mongolia, more than 200 kilometres (120 mi) southwest of the urban area of Heihe.

cities.name: Dengta
cities.description: Dengta is a city in east-central Liaoning province in Northeast China. It is located in between Liaoyang, which oversees Dengta and lies 22 kilometers (14 mi) to the southwest, and Shenyang, the provincial capital which lies nearly double that distance to the northeast.

cities.name: Lhoka
cities.description: Shannan, also known as Lhoka, is a prefecture-level city in the southeastern Tibet Autonomous Region, China. Shannan includes Gonggar County within its jurisdiction with Gongkar Chö Monastery, Gonggar Dzong, and Gonggar Airport all located near Gonggar town.

cities.name: Nanxiong
cities.description: Nanxiong, historically Namyung, Namhung, and Nanhsiung, is a county-level city of northern Guangdong province, People's Republic of China, bordering Jiangxi to the north, east and southeast. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Shaoguan.

cities.name: Xilinhot
cities.description: Xilinhot is a county-level city that serves as the prefectural seat of government for the Xilingol League in Inner Mongolia, China. In 2010, it has a jurisdiction area of 14,785 km2 (5,709 sq mi) and a population of 245,886; 149,000 people live in the Xilinhot urban area.

cities.name: Huairen
cities.description: Huairen is a county-level city in the north of Shanxi province, China. It is under the administration of Shuozhou city.

cities.name: Yidu
cities.description: Yidu is a county-level city in western Hubei Province, China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Yichang.

cities.name: Yong'an
cities.description: Yong'an is a county-level city in west-central Fujian province, People's Republic of China. It is located on the Sha River, which is a tributary of the Min River.

cities.name: Hongjiang
cities.description: Hongjiang, formerly Qianyang County is a county-level city in Hunan Province, China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Huaihua.

cities.name: Huadian
cities.description: Huadian is a city in south-central Jilin province, People's Republic of China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Jilin City.

cities.name: Mishan
cities.description: Mishan is a county-level city in the southeast of Heilongjiang Province, China, bordering Russia's Primorsky Krai to the south and southeast. It is under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Jixi.

cities.name: Lipu
cities.description: Lipu is a county-level city in the northeast of Guangxi, China. It is under the administration of Guilin City, the downtown of which is 100 km (62 mi) to the north.

cities.name: Meng Prefecture
cities.description: Mengzhou is a county-level city in Henan province, People's Republic of China. It is administered by the prefecture-level city Jiaozuo.

cities.name: Lengshuijiang
cities.description: Lengshuijiang is a county-level city in Hunan Province, China, under the administration of Loudi prefecture-level city. Located in central Hunan, the city is bordered to the north and west by Xinhua County, to the south by Xinshao County, and to the east by Lianyuan City.

cities.name: Jiaohe
cities.description: Jiaohe is a middle-sized county-level city in east-central Jilin province, People's Republic of China, bordering Heilongjiang to the northeast. It is under the administration of Jilin City, 65 kilometres (40 mi) to the west, and it is well known for its production of tobacco.

cities.name: Aral
cities.description: Aral (Uyghur: ئارال), also known as Alar, is a sub-prefecture-level city surrounded by Aksu Prefecture in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. Aral means "island" in Uyghur.

cities.name: Kaiyuan
cities.province: Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Kaiyuan is a county-level city within the jurisdiction of Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture in the southeast of Yunnan province, China.

cities.name: Zixing
cities.description: Zixing is a county-level city in Hunan Province, China. It is under the administration of Chenzhou prefecture-level City.

cities.name: Ning'an
cities.description: Ning'an is a city located approximately 20 km (12 mi) southwest of Mudanjiang, in the southeast of Heilongjiang province, China, bordering Jilin province to the south. It is located on the Mudanjiang River (formerly known as Hurka River), which flows north, eventually falling into the Sungari River near Sanxing.

cities.name: Longnan
cities.description: Longnan is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of Ganzhou Municipality, in the far southwest of Jiangxi province, China, bordering Guangdong province to the south.

cities.name: Zalantun
cities.description: Zalantun (Manchu ᠵᠠ ᠯᠠᠨ ᠠᡳ᠌ᠯ; J̌alan Ai"l) or ᠵᠠ ᠯᠠᠨ ᡨᡠ᠋ᠨ; Jalan Tun or Zhalantun) (Mongolian: ᠵᠠᠯᠠᠨ ᠠᠢ᠌ᠯ ; Жалан-Айл), is a city and administrative division of Hulunbuir Prefecture-level city, Inner Mongolia, China. It is in the northeastern part of Inner Mongolia, in the southeastern foothills of the Greater Khingan mountains, bordering Heilongjiang province to the east.

cities.name: Shuangliao
cities.description: Shuangliao is a city in western Jilin, People's Republic of China, bordering Liaoning and Inner Mongolia. It is under the administration of Siping City and was previously the de jure capital of the defunct Liaobei Province.

cities.name: Yangzhong
cities.description: Yangzhong is a county-level city under the administration of Zhenjiang, Jiangsu province, China. It is the easternmost county-level division of Zhenjiang City.

cities.name: Jiayuguan City
cities.description: Jiayuguan City is a prefecture-level city in northwestern Gansu province, with a population of 312,663 as of the 2020 census. Compared with the 231,853 people in the sixth national census in 2010, there was an increase of 80,810 people, with an average annual increase of 3.04%.

cities.name: Bei'an
cities.description: Bei'an is a county-level city in west-central Heilongjiang province in the People's Republic of China. It is under the jurisdiction of Heihe.

cities.name: Taonan
cities.description: Taonan, formerly Tao'an County, is a county-level city of 100,000 in the northwest of Jilin province in Northeast China. It is under the administration of Baicheng prefecture-level city.

cities.name: Shawan
cities.description: Shawan, also transliterated from Chinese to Uyghur as Savan, is a county-level city situated in the north of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region under the administration of the Tacheng Prefecture. It has an area of 12,468 km2 (4,814 sq mi) with a population of 200,000.

cities.name: Binzhou
cities.description: Binzhou, formerly known as Bin County or Binxian, is a county-level city of Xianyang, Shaanxi, China, bordering Gansu province in two disparate sections to the north and west.

cities.name: Wugang
cities.description: Wugang is a county-level city in the south-central part of Henan province, China, administrated by Pingdingshan prefecture-level city. It has a population of approximately 320,000.

cities.name: Wusu
cities.description: Wusu, officially Usu, is a county-level city with more than 100,000 residents in Xinjiang, China. It is a part of Tacheng Prefecture of Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture.

cities.name: Fuquan
cities.province: Qiannan Buyei and Miao Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Fuquan is a county-level city in east-central Guizhou province, China.

cities.name: Lingwu
cities.description: Lingwu is a county-level city of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, Northwest China, it is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Yinchuan. It is the most important industrial city of Ningxia.

cities.name: Dexing
cities.description: Dexing is a county-level city in the northeast of Jiangxi province, China, bordering Zhejiang province to the east. It is under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Shangrao.

cities.name: Hailin
cities.description: Hailin is a county-level city, under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Mudanjiang, in the southeast of Heilongjiang province, China, bordering Jilin province to the southwest. It has an area of 8,816 km2 (3,404 sq mi), and a population of 422,000 (as reported in 2012).

cities.name: Artush
cities.description: Artush ( ar-TUUSH; also transliterated as Artux or Atush) is a county-level city and the capital of Kizilsu Kyrgyz Autonomous Prefecture in Xinjiang, China. The government seat is in Guangming Road Subdistrict.

cities.name: Shaowu
cities.description: Shaowu is a county-level city in northwestern Fujian province, China. It is located in the central part of the Wuyi Mountains and borders Jiangxi province to the west.

cities.name: Huozhou
cities.description: Huozhou, formerly Huo County or Huoxian, is a county-level city in Linfen, in southern Shanxi Province, China. The city spans an area or 765 square kilometers, and has a population of 155,000 as of 2017.

cities.name: Huaying
cities.description: Huaying is a county-level city in the east of Sichuan province, China. It is administered by the prefecture-level city Guang'an.

cities.name: Da'an
cities.description: Da'an is a city of northwestern Jilin province in Northeast China, on the southern bank of the Songhua River and the border with Heilongjiang province. It is under the administration of Baicheng City, 115 kilometres (71 mi) to the west, and lies 57 kilometres (35 mi) northwest of Songyuan.

cities.name: Tumxuk
cities.description: Tumxuk is a county-level city in the western part of Xinjiang, China. The eastern part of Tumxuk is surrounded by Maralbexi County, Kashgar Prefecture.

cities.name: Hulin
cities.description: Hulin is a county-level city on the Muling River in southeastern Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China. With a population of around 200,000, it is under the administration of Jixi.

cities.name: Ruili
cities.province: Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Ruili, called Möng Mao in Tai, is a county-level city of Dehong Prefecture, in the west of Yunnan province, China. It is a major border crossing between China and Myanmar, with the town of Muse located across the border.

cities.name: Wuyishan
cities.description: Wuyishan City is a county-level city in the municipal region of Nanping, in the northwest of Fujian, People's Republic of China, which borders Jiangxi to the northwest. It corresponds to the former Chong'an County.

cities.name: Houma
cities.description: Houma is a county-level city in the southwest of the Shanxi province of the People's Republic of China, on the Fen River - the tributary of Yellow River; it is under the administration of Linfen City. Houma has an area of 220.1 km2 (85.0 sq mi) and has a population of 251,000 as of 2017.

cities.name: Yakeshi
cities.description: Yakeshi is a county-level city of Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, China. Yakeshi has a population of 391,627 and an area of 27,590 square kilometres (10,650 sq mi).

cities.name: Zhangping
cities.description: Zhangping is a county-level city in the southwest of Fujian province, People's Republic of China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Longyan.

cities.name: Longquan
cities.description: Longquan is a county-level city and former county under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Lishui in southwestern Zhejiang Province, China, located on the upper reaches of the Ou River and bordering Fujian province to the southwest.

cities.name: Chishui
cities.description: Chishui is a county-level city of Guizhou Province, China, bordering Sichuan to the north and west. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Zunyi.

cities.name: Bole
cities.description: Bole (English: BO-lə), also known by its Mongolian name Bortala (lit. 'brown steppe'), is a county-level city in Xinjiang, China. It is the seat of Bortala Mongol Autonomous Prefecture, which borders Kazakhstan.

cities.name: Qingtongxia
cities.description: Qingtongxia is a city in north-central Ningxia, China. Administratively, Qingtongxia is a county-level city within the prefecture-level city of Wuzhong.

cities.name: Wudalianchi
cities.description: Wudalianchi, formerly Dedu County, is a county-level city in Heilongjiang province, Northeast China, under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Heihe. The city is served by Wudalianchi Dedu Airport.

cities.name: Hunchun
cities.description: Hunchun is a county-level city in the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture within Jilin province to the far east. It borders North Hamgyong Province in North Korea and Primorsky Krai in Russia, has over 250,000 inhabitants, and covers 5,145 square kilometers.

cities.name: Nyingchi
cities.description: Nyingchi (Tibetan: ཉིང་ཁྲི་གྲོང་ཁྱེར།, Wylie: nying khri grong khyer), also known as Linzhi or Nyingtri, is a prefecture-level city in the southeast of the Tibet Autonomous Region in China. The administrative seat of Nyingchi is Bayi District.

cities.name: Lushan City
cities.description: Lushan City, formerly Xingzi County, is a county-level city in the north of Jiangxi Province, China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Jiujiang.

cities.name: Kuytun
cities.description: Kuytun (Uyghur: كۈيتۇن) or Kuitun is a county-level city with about 285,000 residents (2000 census) in Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang, China. Kuitun is located between Wusu and Shihezi on the railway from Ürümqi to Kazakhstan, close to a desert.

cities.name: Tieli
cities.description: Tieli is a county-level city in Heilongjiang Province, China, on the east bank of the Hulan River. The city has a population of 235,158 (2010).

cities.name: Golmud
cities.province: Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Golmud is a county-level city in the Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture of Qinghai Province, China. It is now the second-largest city in Qinghai and the third largest on the Tibetan Plateau (after Xining and Lhasa).

cities.name: Altay City
cities.description: Altay (also spelled Altai or Aletai) is a county-level city in Altay Prefecture within Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, in far Northern Xinjiang, China. The city centre is located on the banks of Kelan River.

cities.name: Zichang
cities.description: Zichang is a city in the north of Shaanxi province (Shaanbei), China. It is the northernmost county-level division of the prefecture-level city of Yan'an.

cities.name: Dongxing
cities.description: Dongxing is a county-level city within Fangchenggang, Guangxi, China, on the border with Móng Cái, Vietnam. The city spans an area of 549 square kilometers, and has a population of approximately 130,000 as of 2011.

cities.name: Jinshi
cities.description: Jinshi City is a county-level city in Hunan Province, China, under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Changde. Jinshi is located on the north in Hunan Province and the central north in Changde, it borders to the northeast and the northwest by Li County, to the west by Linli County, to the south by Dingcheng District, and to the east by Anxiang County.

cities.name: Gujiao
cities.description: Gujiao is a county-level city of Shanxi Province, North China, it is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Taiyuan. The estimated population of Gujiao in 2017 is about 222,000.

cities.name: Diaobingshan
cities.description: Diaobingshan is a city in the northeast of Liaoning province in Northeast China. It is under the administration of Tieling City, which lies 30 kilometres (19 mi) to the southeast.

cities.name: Huayin
cities.description: Huayin is a county-level city in Weinan, Shaanxi province, China. Prior to 1990, Huayin was regarded as a county.

cities.name: Lushui
cities.description: Lushui is a county-level city in and the seat of Nujiang Prefecture, western Yunnan Province, China. It borders Myanmar's Kachin State to the west and occupies the southern fifth of Nujiang Prefecture.

cities.name: Muling
cities.description: Muling is a county-level city of Mudanjiang, southeastern Heilongjiang province, China, bordering Russia's Primorsky Krai to the east. As of 2004, it has an area of 6,094 square kilometres (2,353 sq mi) and a population of 330,000.

cities.name: Dongning
cities.description: Dongning is a county-level city of southeastern Heilongjiang province, China. It is under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Mudanjiang.

cities.name: Fengzhen
cities.description: Fengzhen is a county-level city under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Ulaan Chab, in the central portion of Inner Mongolia, China, bordering Shanxi province to the south. Fengzhen is about 200 km (120 mi) from Hohhot, the capital of Inner Mongolia.

cities.name: Gongqingcheng
cities.description: Gongqingcheng is a sub-prefecture-level city in Jiangxi, People's Republic of China. It was established on 10 September 2010 in the jurisdiction of Jiujiang.

cities.name: Shangri-La City
cities.description: Shangri-La is a county-level city in northwestern Yunnan province, China, named after Shangri-La, the mythical land depicted in the 1933 novel Lost Horizon. It is the capital and largest city of Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture.

cities.name: Dunhuang
cities.description: Dunhuang () is a county-level city in northwestern Gansu Province, Northwestern China. According to the 2010 Chinese census, the city has a population of 186,027, though 2019 estimates put the city's population at about 191,800.

cities.name: Huating
cities.description: Huating is a county-level city, formerly Huating County, in the east of Gansu province, China, bordering Ningxia to the northwest. It is under the administration of the Pingliang city.

cities.name: Fukang
cities.description: Fukang is a county-level city in Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, China. Its area is 11,726 km2 (4,527 sq mi) and its population in 2007 was reported as approximately 1.5 million.

cities.name: Tongjiang
cities.description: Tongjiang is a city of 160,000 in eastern Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China, located at the confluence and on the right banks of the Songhua and Amur Rivers, the latter which marks the border with Russia. Administratively, it is a county-level city of Jiamusi.

cities.name: Chengjiang
cities.description: Chengjiang is a city located in Yuxi, Yunnan Province, China, just north of Fuxian Lake.

cities.name: Ji'an
cities.description: Ji'an is a county-level city in the southwestern part of Jilin province, People's Republic of China. It is administered by the prefecture-level city of Tonghua and is the southernmost county-level division in the province.

cities.name: Tacheng
cities.description: Tacheng, also known as Qoqek (Uyghur: چۆچەك; Kazakh: شاۋەشەك) and historically as Chuguchak, is a county-level city and the administrative seat of Tacheng Prefecture, in northern Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang. The Chinese name "Tacheng" is an abbreviation of "Tarbagatay City", a reference to the Tarbagatay Mountains.

cities.name: Jinggangshan City
cities.description: Jinggangshan is a county-level city in the southwest of Jiangxi province, People's Republic of China, bordering Hunan province to the west. It is under the administration of the Ji'an City.

cities.name: Manzhouli
cities.description: Manzhouli is a sub-prefectural city in the Hulunbuir prefecture-level city jurisdiction, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China. Located on the border with Russia and also not far from the country of Mongolia, Manzhouli is a major land port of entry.

cities.name: Yushu City
cities.description: Yushu, also Romanized as Yüxü, is a county-level city of Yushu Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in Southern Qinghai Province, China. It comprises a surface area of 13,462 square kilometres (5,198 sq mi).

cities.name: Wujiaqu
cities.description: Wujiaqu is a county-level city in the northern part of Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China, about 40 kilometres (25 mi) north of Ürümqi. Wujiaqu is the headquarter of the 6th Division of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps and currently administered by the 6th Division.

cities.name: Holingol
cities.description: Holingol is a county-level city of Inner Mongolia, China. It has a population of more than 70,000, which includes 17 ethnic groups.

cities.name: Yumen
cities.description: Yumen is a city in western Gansu province, China. It is a county-level city with a population of 106,812 (2002 est.), and is part of Jiuquan "prefecture-level city" (a multi-county administrative unit).

cities.name: Yima
cities.description: Yima is a county-level city under the administration of Sanmenxia in Henan, China. It is located along the old Xiaohan Route, historically serving as a connection between the important eastern and western capitals of Luoyang and Chang'an.

cities.name: Pingxiang
cities.description: Pingxiang is a county-level city under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Chongzuo, in the southwest of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China.

cities.name: Longjing
cities.description: Longjing is a county-level city in the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture, south-eastern Jilin province, China. It lies on the Tumen River, opposite the North Korean city Hoeryong.

cities.name: Kangding
cities.description: Kangding, also known as Dartsedo (Tibetan: དར་རྩེ་མདོ།), is a county-level city and the seat of Garzê Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan province of Southwest China. Kangding is on the bank of the Zheduo River and has been considered the historical border between the Kham region of Tibet and the Sichuan region.

cities.name: Linjiang
cities.description: Linjiang is a county-level city in Baishan, Jilin, China. It is located to the east of Tonghua, and borders North Korea along the Yalu River.

cities.name: Genhe
cities.description: Genhe City or Gegengol, formerly Ergun Left Banner, is a county-level city in the far northeast of Inner Mongolia, China, under the administration of Hulunbuir City. The city spans an area of 19,659 square kilometres (7,590 mi2), and has a total population of 130,722 as of 2019.

cities.name: Helong
cities.description: Helong is a county-level city in southeastern Jilin province, Northeast China. It is under the administration of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture.

cities.name: Suifenhe
cities.description: Suifenhe is a county-level city in southeastern Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China, located where the former Chinese Eastern Railway crosses the border with Russia's town of Pogranichny, Primorsky Krai. In January 2014, Suifenhe became the only Chinese city in which trading with Russian Ruble is officially allowed.

cities.name: Wuzhishan City
cities.description: Wuzhishan (literally, five-point mountain) is a county-level city in the highlands of Hainan Island, China. Although called a "city", Wuzhishan refers to a large land area in Hainan – an area which was once a county.

cities.name: Hezuo
cities.description: Hezuo city, also known as Zö from its Tibetan name (Tibetan: གཙོས་གྲོང་ཁྱེར།, Wylie: Gtsos grong khyer), is the administrative seat of the Gannan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture (TAP) in southern Gansu province in Northwestern China. It is home to the Gêndên Qöling (Zö Gönba) and its Milaraiba Tower, the Langshangmaio Temple, and a mosque.

cities.name: Beitun
cities.description: Beitun is a city in the north of Xinjiang, China. Administratively, it is a county-level city under the direct administration of the regional government, though it is geographically located in Altay Prefecture.

cities.name: Tiemenguan City
cities.description: Tiemenguan is a county-level city in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. It is located 50 kilometres (31 mi) west of Korla and 500 kilometres (310 mi) southwest of the regional capital Ürümqi.

cities.name: Shuifu
cities.description: Shuifu is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Zhaotong, in the northeast of Yunnan province, China, bordering Sichuan to the east and northeast across the Jinsha River.

cities.name: Shaoshan
cities.description: Shaoshan is a county-level city in Hunan Province, China. It is under the administration of the prefecture-level city of Xiangtan.

cities.name: Tongren
cities.description: Tongren, known to Tibetans as Rebgong (Tibetan: རེབ་གོང་, རེབ་ཀོང་ or རེབ་སྐོང་, Amdo Tibetan pronunciation: [ɾɛʋ koŋ]) in the historic region of Amdo, is the capital and second smallest administrative subdivision by area within Huangnan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in Qinghai, China. The city has an area of 3465 square kilometers and a population of ~80,000 (2002), 75% Tibetan.

cities.name: Heshan
cities.description: Heshan is a county-level city of central Guangxi, China, located on the lower reaches of the Hongshui River. It is under the administration of Laibin City.

cities.name: Fuyuan
cities.description: Fuyuan is a county-level city of the province of Heilongjiang, China. It is under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Jiamusi.

cities.name: Delingha
cities.province: Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Delingha, or Delhi (Mongolian: ᠳᠡᠯᠡᠬᠡᠢ ᠬᠣᠲᠠ), is the seat of the Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in northern Qinghai province, China. It is located approximately 200 km (120 mi) southeast of the Da Qaidam Administrative Region.

cities.name: Tumen
cities.description: Tumen is a county-level city in Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture, eastern Jilin province, Northeast China. Of its 136,000 inhabitants, approximately 78,000 (or 57%) are of Korean descent.

cities.name: Erenhot
cities.description: Erenhot is a county-level city under jurisdiction of the Xilingol League, Inner Mongolia, China, located in the Gobi Desert along the Sino-Mongolian border, across from the Mongolian town of Zamyn-Üüd. There are 74,197 inhabitants (2010 census) and the elevation is 966 metres (3,169 ft).

cities.name: Khorgos
cities.description: Khorgos, officially known as Korgas (Kazakh: قورعاس; Uyghur: قورغاس), is a county-level city in Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang, China. It straddles the country's border with Kazakhstan; on the Kazakh side of the border is a city also named Horgos in Russian and Korgas in Kazakh.

cities.name: Kokdala
cities.description: Kokdala or Cocodala is a city in northern Xinjiang, China, bordering Kazakhstan's Almaty Region to the west. Administratively, it is a county-level city under the direct administration of the regional government, though it is geographically located in the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture.

cities.name: Ergun City
cities.description: Ergun, formerly Ergun Right Banner, is a county-level city in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, containing the autonomous region's northernmost point. The city has an area of 28,958 square kilometres (11,181 mi2), and a population of 79,155 as of 2019.

cities.name: Kunyu
cities.description: Kunyu, also known as Kurumkash (Uyghur: قۇرۇمقاش), is a county-level city in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. It is geographically located in Hotan Prefecture of Southern Xinjiang, but is de jure directly administered by the Xinjiang regional government.

cities.name: Mohe City
cities.description: Mohe is a county-level city in Daxing'anling Prefecture, Heilongjiang province. It is the northernmost city in China.

cities.name: Barkam
cities.province: Ngawa Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Barkam or Maerkang or Muerkvua is a county-level city in Ngawa Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture, in the northwest part of Sichuan province, China. The city seat is the town of Barkam.

cities.name: Shuanghe
cities.description: Shuanghe is a county-level city in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. It is located 30 kilometres (19 mi) east of Bole City and 50 kilometres (31 mi) southwest of Alashankou and the border with Kazakhstan.

cities.name: Arxan
cities.description: Arxan (Mongolian: ᠷᠠᠰᠢᠶᠠᠨ lit. "Hot Springs") is a county-level city in the Hinggan League of northeastern Inner Mongolia, China.

cities.name: Huyanghe
cities.description: Huyanghe is a county-level city in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. It is geographically located in Tacheng Prefecture of Northwestern Xinjiang, but is directly administered by the 7th Division of XPCC, which headquartered here.

cities.name: Mainling City
cities.description: Mainling, formerly Mainling County, is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of the prefecture-level city of Nyingchi in eastern Tibet Autonomous Region, China.

cities.name: Mangnai
cities.province: Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture
cities.description: Mangnai, also known as Mang'ai, is a county-level city in the northwest of Qinghai Province, China, bordering Xinjiang to the north and west. It is under the administration of Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture.

cities.name: Tsona City
cities.description: Tsona City, formerly Tsona County, is a county-level city in Shannan Prefecture in the southeastern part of the Tibet region of China. Tsona means "The face of the [Nara Yumco] lake" in Tibetan.

cities.name: Alashankou
cities.description: Alashankou is a border city in Bortala Mongol Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. It is a port of entry by both railroad and highway from Kazakhstan as part of the Eurasian Land Bridge.

cities.name: Sansha
cities.description: Sansha City is a prefecture-level city under the Hainan province of China. It is the southernmost and least populated prefecture in China by far, with the smallest land area but the largest maritime territory.

cities.name: Baiyang
cities.description: Baiyang is a county-level city and a sub-prefectural-level city in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. The county-level city implemented "division and city integration" with the 9th Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

cities.name: Miquan
cities.description: Midong District is one of 7 urban districts of the prefecture-level city of Ürümqi, the capital of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, Northwest China. Its land area is 3,408 km2 (1,316 sq mi); it has a population of 296,000.

cities.name: Xinxing
cities.description: Xinxing is a county-level city in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China. It is actually located with enclaves in Hami.
